description: S8 reverse progress of M7 application/reverse_progress.py (ReverseProgress: _source, status, record), characterized before the move: the eight tests of tests/test_reverse_progress.py that exercise this module (four stages across use-case instances, the idempotent and conflicting retry, unknown/dirty/moved sources and the rebaseline, stage order and the immutable completed stage, the missing/modified/badly described predecessor artifacts, UTF-8 byte counts) and the reverse case of tests/test_integration.py (sequential parts of the racing writers and the replay over a second instance), plus labelled additions for every require and branch of the module (every precondition of record in its order, every source observation of status, the sorted and de-duplicated references), with the digests of reverse_requests, reverse_progress, reverse_history and the whole store before and after every call; MemoryStore, M7's own FileArtifacts over a run-scoped directory, scripted clock, no git, no PostgreSQL
